text.KJV: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
text.ASV: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh glad the life; and money answereth all things.
text.WEB: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

text.KJV: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
text.ASV: Revile not the king, no, not in thy thought; and revile not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
text.WEB: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom: for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.

text.KJV: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
text.ASV: Cast thy bread upon the waters; for thou shalt find it after many days.
text.WEB: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

text.KJV: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
text.ASV: Give a portion to seven, yea, even unto eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
text.WEB: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.

text.KJV: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
text.ASV: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth; and if a tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there shall it be.
text.WEB: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.

text.KJV: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
text.ASV: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
text.WEB: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

text.KJV: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
text.ASV: As thou knowest not what is the way of the wind, `nor' how the bones `do grow' in the womb of her that is with child; even so thou knowest not the work of God who doeth all.
text.WEB: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.

text.KJV: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
text.ASV: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thy hand; for thou knowest not which shall prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
text.WEB: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.

text.KJV: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
text.ASV: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun.
text.WEB: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to see the sun.

text.KJV: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
text.ASV: Yea, if a man live many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
text.WEB: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.

text.KJV: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
text.ASV: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth, and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thy heart, and in the sight of thine eyes; but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
text.WEB: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.

text.KJV: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
text.ASV: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.
text.WEB: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.

text.KJV: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
text.ASV: Remember also thy Creator in the days of thy youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
text.WEB: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them”;

text.KJV: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
text.ASV: before the sun, and the light, and the moon, and the stars, are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;
text.WEB: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;

text.KJV: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
text.ASV: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows shall be darkened,
text.WEB: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

text.KJV: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
text.ASV: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;
text.WEB: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;

text.KJV: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
text.ASV: yea, they shall be afraid of `that which is' high, and terrors `shall be' in the way; and the almond-tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goeth to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets:
text.WEB: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets:

text.KJV: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
text.ASV: before the silver cord is loosed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern,
text.WEB: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,

text.KJV: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
text.ASV: and the dust returneth to the earth as it was, and the spirit returneth unto God who gave it.
text.WEB: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

text.KJV: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
text.ASV: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher; all is vanity.
text.WEB: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”

text.KJV: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
text.ASV: And further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he pondered, and sought out, `and' set in order many proverbs.
text.WEB: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

text.KJV: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
text.ASV: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written uprightly, `even' words of truth.
text.WEB: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

text.KJV: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
text.ASV: The words of the wise are as goads; and as nails well fastened are `the words of' the masters of assemblies, `which' are given from one shepherd.
text.WEB: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

text.KJV: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
text.ASV: And furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
text.WEB: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

text.KJV: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
text.ASV: `This is' the end of the matter; all hath been heard: fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole `duty' of man.
text.WEB: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

text.KJV: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
text.ASV: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
text.WEB: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
